sentences.s: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well-connected.

trunk.宾语或表语: that "social epidemics" are driven ... by the acting of a tiny minority of special individuals
trunk.主干翻译: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔认为，"社会流行潮"在很大程度上是由一小群特殊个体的行为所推动的。

components.原文: The Tipping Point
components.中文翻译: 《引爆点》
components.说明: his book 的同位语，点明书名。

components.原文: that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well-connected
components.中文翻译: "社会流行潮"在很大程度上是由一小群特殊个体的行为所推动的，这些人常被称为有影响力者，他们见多识广、能言善道或人脉广博，异于常人。
components.说明: 由 that 引导，作 argues 的宾语。

components.原文: often called influentials
components.中文翻译: 常被称为"有影响力者"
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 individuals 的后置定语（兼具同位说明作用）。

components.原文: who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well-connected
components.中文翻译: 他们异乎寻常地见多识广、富有说服力或人脉广博
components.说明: who 引导的定语从句，修饰 special individuals。

components.原文: informed, persuasive, or well-connected
components.中文翻译: 见多识广、富有说服力或人脉广博
components.说明: 三个表语形容词由 or 并列。

sentences.zh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在其著作《引爆点》中提出，"社会流行潮"在很大程度上是由一小群特殊个体的行为推动的，这些人常被称为"有影响力者"，他们异乎寻常地见多识广、富有说服力或人脉广博。

sentences.s: The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread.

trunk.主干翻译: 这一观点很有说服力，但它并未解释观念实际是如何传播的。

components.原文: but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread
components.中文翻译: 但它并没有解释观念实际上是如何传播的
components.说明: 由 but 连接的并列分句，与前一分句构成转折并列。

components.原文: how ideas actually spread
components.中文翻译: 观念实际上是如何传播的
components.说明: how 引导，作 explain 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 这一观点凭直觉看颇具说服力，但它并未解释观念实际上是如何传播的。

sentences.s: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else.

trunk.宾语或表语: a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory
trunk.主干翻译: 所谓有影响力者的重要性，源自一个听上去合理但大体未经检验的理论。

components.原文: called the "two-step flow of communication"
components.中文翻译: 被称为"传播的两级流动"
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 theory 的后置定语，兼点明该理论名称。

components.原文: : Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else
components.中文翻译: 信息先从媒体流向有影响力者，再从他们流向其他所有人
components.说明: 冒号后的句子对 theory 作进一步解释说明（同位/阐释成分）。

components.原文: from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else
components.中文翻译: 从媒体流向有影响力者，并从他们流向其他所有人
components.说明: 两个 from...to... 介词短语由 and 并列作 flows 的状语。

sentences.zh: 所谓有影响力者的重要性，源自一个听上去合理但大体上未经检验的理论，即"传播的两级流动"：信息先从媒体流向有影响力者，再由他们流向其他所有人。

sentences.s: Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them.

trunk.主干翻译: 营销人员欣然接受了这种两级流动理论。

components.原文: because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them
components.中文翻译: 因为它暗示，只要他们能找到并影响那些有影响力者，被选中的人就会替他们完成大部分工作
components.说明: because 引导原因状语从句，说明营销人员接受该理论的原因。

components.原文: that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them
components.中文翻译: 只要他们能找到并影响那些有影响力者，被选中的人就会替他们完成大部分工作
components.说明: that 引导，作 suggests 的宾语。

components.原文: if they can just find and influence the influentials
components.中文翻译: 只要他们能找到并影响那些有影响力者
components.说明: if 引导条件状语从句，修饰主句谓语 will do。

components.原文: find and influence the influentials
components.中文翻译: 找到并影响那些有影响力者
components.说明: find 与 influence 两个动词由 and 并列。

sentences.zh: 营销人员欣然接受了这种两级流动理论，因为它暗示：只要能找到并影响那些有影响力者，这些被选中的人就会替他们完成大部分工作。

sentences.s: The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods.

trunk.宾语或表语: the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods
trunk.主干翻译: 该理论似乎还能解释某些造型、品牌或街区突如其来、出人意料的流行。

components.原文: to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods
components.中文翻译: 解释某些造型、品牌或街区突如其来、出人意料的流行
components.说明: 动词不定式与 seems 构成 seem to do 结构，作 seems 的补足成分。

components.原文: certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods
components.中文翻译: 某些造型、品牌或街区
components.说明: 三个名词由 or 并列，作 of 的宾语。

sentences.zh: 该理论似乎还能解释某些造型、品牌或街区突如其来、出人意料的走红。

sentences.s: In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention.

trunk.宾语或表语: that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is
trunk.主干翻译: 对成因的粗略查考会发现，某个小群体一直在穿戴、推广或开发某种事物。

components.原文: In many such cases
components.中文翻译: 在许多此类情形中
components.说明: 介词短语作句首状语，限定语境。

components.原文: that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention
components.中文翻译: 在其他任何人留意之前，某个小群体就一直在穿戴、推广或开发某种事物
components.说明: that 引导，作 finds 的宾语。

components.原文: wearing, promoting, or developing
components.中文翻译: 穿戴、推广或开发
components.说明: 三个现在分词由 or 并列，构成过去进行时谓语。

components.原文: whatever it is
components.中文翻译: 无论那是什么东西
components.说明: whatever 引导的从句作 wearing/promoting/developing 的宾语。

components.原文: before anyone else paid attention
components.中文翻译: 在其他任何人留意之前
components.说明: before 引导时间状语从句。

sentences.zh: 在许多此类情形中，对成因的粗略查考会发现：早在其他人留意之前，某个小群体就一直在穿戴、推广或开发某种东西。

sentences.s: Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.

trunk.主干翻译: 这类轶事性证据与这一观点正好相符。

components.原文: that only certain special people can drive trends
components.中文翻译: 只有某些特殊人物才能引领潮流
components.说明: that 引导，对 the idea 作同位语说明。

sentences.zh: 这类轶事性证据恰好印证了这样一种观点：只有某些特殊人物才能引领潮流。

sentences.s: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.

trunk.主干翻译: 一些研究者得出了这一发现。

components.原文: however
components.中文翻译: 然而
components.说明: 插入语，表转折语气。

components.原文: In their recent work
components.中文翻译: 在他们近期的研究中
components.说明: 介词短语作句首状语。

components.原文: that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed
components.中文翻译: 有影响力者对社会流行潮的影响远比人们普遍设想的要小
components.说明: that 引导，对 the finding 作同位语说明。

components.原文: than is generally supposed
components.中文翻译: 比人们普遍设想的（要小）
components.说明: than 引导比较状语从句，与 far less 呼应。

sentences.zh: 然而，一些研究者在其近期研究中得出了这样一个发现：有影响力者对社会流行潮的影响，远比人们通常设想的要小得多。

sentences.s: In fact, they don't seem to be required at all.

trunk.主干翻译: 事实上，他们似乎根本就不是必需的。

components.原文: to be required at all
components.中文翻译: 根本就是必需的
components.说明: 不定式与 seem 构成 seem to be 结构，作 seem 的补足成分。

components.原文: In fact
components.中文翻译: 事实上
components.说明: 句首插入性状语，承接上文。

sentences.zh: 事实上，他们似乎根本就不是必需的。

sentences.s: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey—whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence—even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.

trunk.宾语或表语: a simple observation about social influence
trunk.主干翻译: 研究者的论点源于一个关于社会影响的简单观察。

components.原文: even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others
components.修饰对象: a simple observing about social influence
components.中文翻译: 即便是人群中最有影响力的成员，也根本不会与那么多其他人互动
components.说明: 冒号后的分句，对 observing 的内容作具体阐述。

components.原文: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey
components.中文翻译: 除了像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样的少数名人之外
components.说明: 介词短语作状语，表示例外。

components.原文: whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence
components.中文翻译: 他们超大的影响力主要是媒体影响（而非人际影响）的产物
components.说明: 由 whose 引导的定语从句，修饰 celebrities，破折号间插入；其中 media, not interpersonal 共同修饰 influence。

sentences.zh: 研究者的论点源于一个关于社会影响的简单观察：除了像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样超大影响力主要源自媒体而非人际影响的少数名人之外，即便是人群中最有影响力的成员，也根本不会与那么多其他人互动。

sentences.s: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.

trunk.宾语或表语: these non-celebrity influentials who ... are supposed to drive social epidemics
trunk.主干翻译: 然而，恰恰是这些非名人的有影响力者，被认为推动着社会流行潮。

components.原文: it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics
components.中文翻译: 正是这些非名人的有影响力者……被认为推动着社会流行潮
components.说明: it is ... who ... 强调句型，强调主语 these non-celebrity influentials。

components.原文: according to the two-step-flow theory
components.中文翻译: 根据两级流动理论
components.说明: 插入语，交代论断依据。

components.原文: to drive social epidemics
components.中文翻译: 推动社会流行潮
components.说明: 不定式与 be supposed 构成 be supposed to do 结构。

components.原文: by influencing their friends and colleagues directly
components.中文翻译: 通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事
components.说明: by + 动名词短语作方式状语，修饰 drive。

sentences.zh: 然而，根据两级流动理论，恰恰正是这些非名人的有影响力者，被认为通过直接影响其朋友和同事来推动社会流行潮。

sentences.s: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.

trunk.宾语或表语: his or her own acquaintances / little to do with the initial influential
trunk.主干翻译: 每个受影响者必须再去影响自己的熟人；而有多少人关注每个人，与最初的有影响力者关系不大。

components.原文: For a social epidemic to occur
components.中文翻译: 要使一场社会流行潮发生
components.说明: for + 不定式复合结构作条件/目的状语，修饰主句 must influence。

components.原文: however
components.中文翻译: 然而
components.说明: 插入语，表转折。

components.原文: so affected
components.中文翻译: 如此受影响的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 each person 的后置定语。

components.原文: who must in turn influence theirs, and so on
components.中文翻译: 这些熟人又必须转而去影响他们各自的熟人，如此循环往复
components.说明: who 引导的非限定性定语从句，修饰 acquaintances。

components.原文: and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential
components.中文翻译: 而有多少人关注其中每个人，与最初的有影响力者关系不大
components.说明: 分号后由 and 连接的并列分句，其主语为 how 引导的主语从句。

components.原文: just how many others pay attention to each of
components.中文翻译: 究竟有多少人关注其中每一个人
components.说明: how 引导的从句作并列分句的主语。

sentences.zh: 然而，要使一场社会流行潮发生，每个如此受影响的人都必须再去影响自己的熟人，这些熟人又须转而影响他们各自的熟人，如此循环往复；而究竟有多少人关注其中每一个人，与最初的有影响力者并无多大关系。

sentences.s: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.

trunk.主干翻译: 这场变化的连锁反应就不会传播很远，也不会波及很多人。

components.原文: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant
components.中文翻译: 如果网络中与最初的有影响力者仅隔两层的人表现出抵触
components.说明: if 引导条件状语从句；其中 just two degrees removed from... 为后置定语修饰 people。

components.原文: for example
components.中文翻译: 举例来说
components.说明: 插入语，举例衔接。

components.原文: propagate very far or affect many people
components.中文翻译: 传播很远或波及很多人
components.说明: propagate 与 affect 两个谓语由 or 并列，共用 won't。

sentences.zh: 举例来说，如果网络中与最初的有影响力者仅隔两层的人表现出抵触，那么这场变化的连锁反应就既不会传播很远，也不会波及很多人。

sentences.s: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.

trunk.主干翻译: 研究者们研究了社会影响的动态机制。

components.原文: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence
components.中文翻译: 基于关于人际影响的这一基本事实
components.说明: 现在分词短语作伴随/方式状语，修饰 studied。

components.原文: by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations
components.中文翻译: 通过对人群进行成千上万次计算机模拟
components.说明: by + 动名词短语作方式状语。

components.原文: manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced
components.中文翻译: 并操控一系列与人们影响他人的能力及其受影响的倾向有关的变量
components.说明: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，补充 conducting 的具体做法。

components.原文: relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced
components.中文翻译: 与人们影响他人的能力及其受影响的倾向有关的
components.说明: 现在分词短语作 variables 的后置定语。

components.原文: to influence others
components.中文翻译: 影响他人的
components.说明: 不定式作 ability 的后置定语。

components.原文: people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced
components.中文翻译: 人们影响他人的能力及其受影响的倾向
components.说明: ability 与 tendency 两个名词短语由 and 并列。

components.原文: to be influenced
components.中文翻译: 受影响的
components.说明: 不定式作 tendency 的后置定语。

sentences.zh: 基于关于人际影响的这一基本事实，研究者们通过对人群进行成千上万次计算机模拟，并操控一系列与人们影响他人的能力及其受影响倾向有关的变量，研究了社会影响的动态机制。

sentences.s: They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades"—the widespread propagation of influence through networks—is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.

trunk.宾语或表语: that ... the principal requirement ... is the presence ... of a critical mass of easily influenced people
trunk.主干翻译: 他们发现，关键要求并不在于少数有影响力者，而在于存在大量易受影响的人。

components.原文: that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades"—the widespread propagation of influence through networks—is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people
components.中文翻译: 所谓"全局级联"……的首要条件，并非存在少数有影响力者，而是存在大量易受影响的人
components.说明: that 引导，作 found 的宾语。

components.原文: what is called "global cascades"
components.中文翻译: 所谓的"全局级联"
components.说明: what 引导的从句作介词 for 的宾语。

components.原文: the widespread propagation of influence through networks
components.中文翻译: 即影响在网络中的广泛传播
components.说明: 破折号间的名词短语作 "global cascades" 的同位语解释。

components.原文: not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people
components.中文翻译: 不在于少数有影响力者，而在于大量易受影响的人
components.说明: not...but... 并列结构，两个 of 短语作 the presence 的定语。

sentences.zh: 他们发现，所谓"全局级联"（即影响在网络中的广泛传播）的首要条件，并不在于存在少数有影响力者，而恰恰在于存在大量易受影响的人。
